name: relay-workbench
description: A local workbench for running coding agents through a staged, human-approved workflow

scripts.build: pnpm --dir web run build && go -C go build -o ../.relay/bin/relay-go ./cmd/relay-go
scripts.test: go -C go test ./... && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.test:browser: pnpm --dir web run test:e2e && pnpm --dir web run test:workspace && pnpm --dir web run test:ui
